name: D Maris Bay
positioning: Beach resort in a secluded cove on the protected Datca Peninsula, on a pine-covered hillside where the Aegean meets the Mediterranean
best_for: Beach lovers who want a choice of private beaches with cabanas and floating daybeds
Active travelers who want watersports, sailing and tennis
Families who want a Kids Club near a family-friendly beach

facts.text: D Maris Bay's secluded cove is set in the protected reservation area of the Datca Peninsula, on Turkey's Turquoise Coast.
The resort sits on a pine-covered hillside.
The bay lies where the Aegean meets the Mediterranean.
The surrounding sea is home to marine life including rare loggerhead sea turtles and monk seals.
Rooms feature Italian marble and polished teak wood, with a choice of sea or mountain views.
Suites have views over the bay or the volcanic mountains, with details such as travertine stone.
Rooms come with housekeeping twice a day and 24-hour room service.
Mytha Spa draws its inspiration from nature.
Fitness offerings include sunrise yoga, fitness classes and a fully equipped D-Gym.
A specialist watersports centre offers wakeboarding, sailing, surfing, kayaking, diving and waterskiing with expert instructors.
The resort has tennis hard courts and a padel court.
Restaurants include Zuma, Nusr-Et, Aurora Capri, Manos, La Guerite and D Maris Kitchen.

highlights.text: Maris Beach is a palm-dotted beach with a beachside spa treatment room, private cabanas (one with its own Jacuzzi) and a floating daybed suspended above the sea.
The D Maris Bay Villa has its own private pool in lush gardens, Calacatta marble bathrooms and a Gaggenau kitchen with 24-hour butler service.
La Guerite Beach is a private, palm-fringed stretch of sand with raffia-shaded loungers, canopied daybeds and sunset DJ sets.
Guests can rent a catamaran to explore hidden coves and nearby islands, or take lessons at the international sailing school.
The Maris Kids Club works with Worldwide Kids, a luxury childcare provider.

considerations.text: The resort is secluded: it is 130 km from Dalaman International Airport, 155 km from Bodrum Airport and 35 km from the city of Marmaris.
La Guerite Beach has sunset DJ sets and parties until late; Zuma x Silence Beach is the quiet option, without music.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing at the higher end of the Marmaris resort market.
